source_coverage.coverage_comment: Extraction is based on a structured course syllabus (description) detailing topics, tools, outcomes, and prerequisites.
Extraction is based on a structured course syllabus document detailing prerequisites, topics, outcomes, and technologies.

The analysis is based on the official syllabus, all 9 uploaded lab descriptions, and 9 uploaded lecture decks. Some lecture topics from the syllabus were not accompanied by separate lecture PDFs in the upload set, so finer-grained details for a few subtopics were reconstructed conservatively from the syllabus and related labs rather than inferred beyond the evidence.
Extraction is based on a single concise syllabus document detailing topics, prerequisites, and learning outcomes. Lab and lecture contents are inferred from the syllabus structure.

Analysis used the official syllabus, laboratory works 1-6, and lectures 1-11. The syllabus also lists later topics and labs on audio messages, GPT-supported NLP, and global information space, but those source documents were not uploaded, so they are treated as scope-level topics rather than strongly evidenced output skills.
